description: A headline number for a post, slide or dashboard: how many MCP servers the Official MCP Registry lists, split by status (active, deprecated), remote transport (streamable-http, sse) and package type (npm, pypi, ...). Good for 'How many MCP servers are there, and how many run remotely?'. Example: registry_totals() -> {unique_servers, by_status, by_remote_transport, by_package_type}. No arguments.
name: registry_totals
